name: FoxGate AntiVPN (Free)
license: All rights reserved (free edition, not redistributed by this benchmark)

shipped.note: As downloaded: 5 keyless services (zowi in its security-only mode, Blackbox, funkemunky, IPLocate, marvinmc), IP range lists, maxFlags 5, blocks on detection.

enforce.note: Enforces out of the box; no step needed.

proxycheck_key.note: enforce + the free ProxyCheck key through the product's documented key field (same key for every product).

free_keys.note: Enables the bundled ProxyCheck and VPNAPI service definitions with keys (documented in the service files).

optimal.note: PROVISIONAL, carried over from 1.2.0-pre10: the 12 services pre10 shipped (pre12 turns seven of them off; they are switched back on here through their documented `enabled` field), plus ProxyCheck and VPNAPI with free keys, free keys for ipapi.is and IPLocate, and maxFlags 6. Simulated for pre10 on the providers run of 13 Oct: 370 of 378 caught and 5 of 310 refused. pre12 reads zowi in security mode (same flags) and ProxyCheck v3 (more flags, hosting among them), so the profile is re-derived from the next providers run.

redis_note: No Redis storage option (SQL databases via HikariCP only). Redis test not applicable.
documented_failure_policy: Not documented in the listing; services that fail are skipped (observed).
telemetry: self-updater (configuration.updates.automatic) - blocked so the artifact under test cannot change
list_sources_note: Lists the shipped configuration downloads (from its generated config); used only for the circularity table. central.zowi.gay/tors is FoxGate's Tor list with other providers, also used when the Tor Project is down (author, 7 Oct 2026).
lookup_hosts_note: api.zowi.gay (one GET per player address) was missing until 7 Oct 2026: runs before that sent FoxGate's zowi lookups to the live service in the performance family and left them unfaulted in the failure family.
pins_note: 1.2.0-pre12 (Modrinth release of 18 Oct 2026) as its own adapter, like connection-guard-061 and proxyshield-310, so results of 1.2.0-pre10 (adapter `foxgate`) keep their label. Resource files differ from pre10 only in the service files: seven services are off by default (IP-API, ip-check.net, ipapi.is, IPQuery, iprisk, Negativity, rayzs.de), zowi is asked with feature=security (also reading the crawler flag), ProxyCheck moved to API v3 and IPLocate adds 2 flags (vls) per detection. config.yml is unchanged.
